title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Judges 8: Gideon pursues the kings of Midian, punishes Succoth and Penuel, refuses to rule and makes an ephod.

questions.text: Who rebuked Gideon sharply for not calling them when he went to fight Midian?
questions.explanation: The men of Ephraim said, "Why have you treated us this way, that you didn't call us?" and rebuked him sharply.

questions.text: What were the names of the kings of Midian whom Gideon was pursuing?
questions.explanation: Gideon told the men of Succoth he was pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.

questions.text: With what did Gideon threaten to tear the flesh of the men of Succoth?
questions.explanation: Gideon said he would tear their flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

answers.text: The whips of the Midianite kings
Thorns of the wilderness and briers

questions.text: What did Gideon say he would break down at Penuel?
questions.explanation: He said to the men of Penuel, "When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower."

questions.text: How many princes and elders of Succoth did the young man describe to Gideon?
questions.explanation: The young man described the princes of Succoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.

questions.text: Why did Jether, Gideon's firstborn, not draw his sword to kill the kings?
questions.explanation: The youth didn't draw his sword, for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

answers.text: He had been wounded in battle
His sword had been taken from him
He was afraid, because he was still a youth
He wanted to keep the kings alive

questions.text: How did Gideon answer when the men of Israel asked him to rule over them?
questions.explanation: Gideon said, "I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you."

answers.text: "I will rule, and my son after me."
"Let my son Jether rule over you."

questions.text: What did Gideon ask each man to give him from the plunder?
questions.explanation: Gideon asked that each would give him the earrings of his plunder, for they had golden earrings.

questions.text: What did Gideon make out of the gold and put in his city Ophrah?
questions.explanation: Gideon made an ephod out of it and put it in Ophrah, and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

questions.text: What was the name of the son borne to Gideon by his concubine in Shechem?
questions.explanation: His concubine who was in Shechem bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
